method: Default domain weights; equal applicable evidenced metric weights within domains; M6 excluded and M1-M5 share 10%. U never imputed.

metric_coverage.note: Not code, platform, test, standard or workload coverage. Unverified subclaims are explicit in REPORT.md.

metrics.name: Completeness
metrics.evidence: Native document, vector, temporal and service workflows exist (E01–E05, E08).
metrics.deficiency: Source synchronization is absent; adapters expose different subsets.

metrics.name: Correctness
metrics.evidence: Canonical ranking tests and 1,110 fresh Rust passes; five new counterexamples (E10–E14).
metrics.deficiency: Verification, text, history, identity and Python boundary contracts still fail.

metrics.name: Depth
metrics.evidence: BM25/Boolean/phrase, dense/ANN, temporal facts, provenance, local models (E02–E08).
metrics.deficiency: Research reasoning and learned task utility are not established.

metrics.name: Workflow coverage
metrics.evidence: Native lifecycle and temporal source fixtures, HTTP/MCP workflows (E04, E14–E15).
metrics.deficiency: Learned native QA U; imports do not synchronize later source deletion.

metrics.name: Consistency
metrics.evidence: Shared Rust contracts and typed errors; divergent JS/Python paths (E09–E13).
metrics.deficiency: Same operation has different identity, text and failure semantics across adapters.

metrics.name: Interoperability
metrics.evidence: Official MCP clients, independent W3C/receipt fixtures and many bindings (E08, E15).
metrics.deficiency: Bounded profiles, differing runtime capabilities; complete certification U.

metrics.name: Architecture
metrics.evidence: Writer lease, immutable captures and publication gate (E03).
metrics.deficiency: HmsCore breadth, separate index lifecycles and sidecar commit boundaries.

metrics.name: Code quality
metrics.evidence: Rust types, checked bounds and lint gates; source inspection (E02–E09, E17).
metrics.deficiency: Duplicated OrderedLog, unchecked optional research allocation and wrapper validation holes.

metrics.name: Extensibility
metrics.evidence: Feature gates and policy traits; explicit experimental modules (E01, E04).
metrics.deficiency: Adapters independently reproduce storage semantics; broad public internal modules.

metrics.name: Dependencies
metrics.evidence: Lockfiles, optional heavy dependencies, deny policy and pinned CI (E01, E17).
metrics.deficiency: Unmaintained bincode/paste exceptions and conditional model dependency exposure.

metrics.name: State/data integrity
metrics.evidence: Journal/restore strong; actual history and identity counterexamples (E03, E11, E13).
metrics.deficiency: Auxiliary evidence is not recoverably coupled; adapter state invariants fail.

metrics.name: Maintainability
metrics.evidence: Regression fixtures, version gates, clear ownership in core (E14–E17).
metrics.deficiency: Multiple runtimes, duplicate logic and stale documentation increase change cost.

metrics.name: Standards conformance
metrics.evidence: Scoped COSE/VC/SCITT/OAuth implementation with independent evidence (E06, E08, E15).
metrics.deficiency: GCM lifetime policy absent; status allocation SHOULD deviation; full profiles U.

metrics.name: Interface/API design
metrics.evidence: Generated schemas, capabilities, pagination, committed/resource errors (E08).
metrics.deficiency: Boolean integrity and best-effort Vec results lose outcome information.

metrics.name: Protocol interoperability
metrics.evidence: Official SDK and actual HTTP/TLS tests; independent receipt encodings (E08, E14–E15).
metrics.deficiency: Full MCP 2026 malformed-header suite and deployment authority behavior U.

metrics.name: Discoverability
metrics.evidence: Capability discovery, CLI/docs and examples (E01, E08).
metrics.deficiency: Standards and schema documentation conflict with current implementation.

metrics.name: Compatibility
metrics.evidence: Golden formats, MSRV/platform gates and explicit upgrades (E03, E15, E17).
metrics.deficiency: Published package/source drift; model features have a higher compiler floor.

metrics.name: Integration fidelity
metrics.evidence: Native source/quote checks pass; JS byte corruption and relabeling reproduced (E04, E11).
metrics.deficiency: Full record text and embedding-function semantics are not preserved everywhere.

metrics.name: Reliability
metrics.evidence: Fresh service/core suites and recorded Windows repair gate (E14, E17).
metrics.deficiency: Optional cognition shutdown and malformed Python inputs are weaker boundaries.

metrics.name: Recovery
metrics.evidence: Restore intent and journal crash tests; interrupted history clear reproduced (E03, E13).
metrics.deficiency: Sidecar reconciliation absent; failed-I/O ambiguity needs fault injection.

metrics.name: Security
metrics.evidence: AEAD, scoped auth, safe identity publication; integrity verifier fails open (E06–E10).
metrics.deficiency: False provenance assurance; independent crypto/DP review and key-use ceiling absent.

metrics.name: Data safety
metrics.evidence: Core deletion/ownership/compaction tests strong; real adapter failures (E03, E11, E13).
metrics.deficiency: History can reappear; returned text can change; erasure excludes snapshots/readers.

metrics.name: Performance
metrics.evidence: Recorded Pareto points and bounded retrieval ablations (E15–E16).
metrics.deficiency: No current broad frontier result; hot-query regression and historical ingest/RSS losses.

metrics.name: Scalability
metrics.evidence: Bounded requests/deltas; explicit dense caps and stale O(N) discovery (E02, E05, E08).
metrics.deficiency: High-dimensional capacity U; retained per-thread scratch and unbounded cognition.

metrics.name: Developer experience
metrics.evidence: Working package/native paths and diagnostics (E01, E09, E14).
metrics.deficiency: Uneven runtime features and published/source mismatch require careful selection.

metrics.name: Documentation
metrics.evidence: Extensive evidence and honest benchmark caveats (E01, E15–E16).
metrics.deficiency: Current standards/schema/adapter descriptions have material drift.

metrics.name: Validation
metrics.evidence: Fresh 1,110 passes, golden/property/crash tests, independent interop (E14–E17).
metrics.deficiency: Missing adversarial adapter lifecycle/identity/text tests allowed five defects.

metrics.name: Observability
metrics.evidence: Prometheus metrics, structured HTTP logs, explain/status APIs (E04, E08).
metrics.deficiency: Evidence completeness, planner refusal and retained scratch lack unified diagnostics.

metrics.name: Competitive differentiation
metrics.evidence: Integrated local search/temporal/security surface and selected measured wins (E15–E16).
metrics.deficiency: No general Pareto leadership or held-out native learned-QA advantage.

metrics.name: Innovation potential
metrics.evidence: Existing query-aware routing, temporal ownership and VSA mechanisms (E02–E07).
metrics.deficiency: Forward-looking utility and research novelty remain experimentally unverified.
